channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Breakdown on N27 South City Link - Long Delays
item.description: Reports of a breakdown, inbound, on the N27 South City Link. Long delays as a result.

item.title: Wrong Way Driver on M8 Northbound
item.description: Reports of wrong way driver, northbound, on the M8 Dublin Motorway between Junction 18 Glanmire and Junction 17 Watergrasshill (2 kilometres north of the Cork area). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 28 February at 14:15.

item.title: Collision on N20 Ballyhea
item.description: Reports of a collision on the N20 at Ballyhea. Emergency services and NAS Helicopter are on scene. Take care on approach.

item.title: ⚠️ Yellow Rainfall Warning Issued for Cork
item.description: Met Éireann has issued a Yellow - Rainfall Warning for Cork. Valid: 00:00 Sunday 1 March until 00:00 Monday 2 March, further information will be issued shortly. Further information via met.ie.

item.title: Yellow Rainfall Warning Issued for Cork and Three Other Counties
item.description: Yellow rainfall warning for Cork from midnight tonight until midnight Monday. Heavy rain, flooding risk and poor visibility expected.

item.title: Collision on N8 Lower Glanmire Road
item.description: Reports of a collision in the left lane on the N8 Lower Glanmire Road, towards the Dunkettle roundabout. Take care on approach.

item.title: Animal on N40 Westbound
item.description: Reports of a dog, westbound, on the N40 South Ring Road just before Wilton, walking in-and-out of traffic. Take extreme care on approach.

item.title: Animals on Road on N40 Westbound
item.description: Reports of animals on road, westbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Junction 3 (N71) Bandon Road and Junction 2 Curraheen (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 28 February at 16:09.

item.title: E-Scooters on N25 Eastbound - Wrong Way
item.description: Reports of two e-scooters travelling the wrong way on the N25 eastbound, on the hard shoulder, just west of the Midleton R630 exit. Riders are in dark clothing, and unlit. Take extreme care on approach.

item.title: Collision on Ballynoe Road Cobh
item.description: Reports of a collision on Ballynoe Road, near the junction with Daniel O'Halloran Place, Cobh. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.
